text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just before running in the Kyoto 
Daishoten, the race results for the 
Mainichi Okan arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"The Otherworldly Escapist" Silence Suzuka 
breaks away, leaving El Condor Pasa and 
Grass Wonder far behind to secure a 
runaway victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If the East is hyping things up, he'd make 
the West even hotter. Seiun Sky burned 
with fighting spirit.
